tagged_fluctuations.tag_protocol: One sharp load, native half splitter, number read, both rails parked through the supplied conditional preparation and word or fringe read.
tagged_fluctuations.source_reference: log[(1/9)/P0] in nats from the specified calibrated reference
tagged_fluctuations.comparison: Same fair occupancy tag in both preparations. Conditional source uses P- and P+; independent source uses P0 for both tag values.
tagged_fluctuations.observable: Z times oriented word cycle, with Z = -1 on the first parked port and +1 on the other
